mapper.select: select id, admin_id, admin_name, password, role, status, last_login_time, create_time, update_time from admin where admin_name = #{adminName} limit 1
select id, admin_id, admin_name, password, role, status, last_login_time, create_time, update_time from admin where id = #{id} limit 1
select id, admin_id, admin_name, password, role, status, last_login_time, create_time, update_time from admin order by create_time desc, id desc
mapper.insert: insert into admin (admin_id, admin_name, password, role, status) values (#{adminId}, #{adminName}, #{password}, #{role}, #{status})
